- a. Once approved, the Contractor's Quality Control Manager shall have full authority to represent and act for the Contractor on all quality related matters.
- b. Notify the Contract Administrator / Supervision Consultant in writing prior to re-assigning any of the designated quality control personnel.
- c. Obtain Contract Administrator / Supervision Consultant's approval for replacement prior to reassigning or re-locating approved quality controlpersonnel.
- C. List of Proposed Suppliers and Sub-Contractors
1. List shall include the following:
- a. Items to be supplied by each supplier and sub-contractor.
- b. Model or catalogue numbers.
8. c.Specifications.
9. d . Inspection and test requiremerits.
10. e.Performance data.
- f. Anticipated inspection and test dates.
- g. Name and location of quarries and procedures for work in quarries.
2. List other pertinent information as appropriate.
- D. Submit inspection and test results, certificates of compllance, and certifled material test reports to the Contract Administrator / Supervision Consultant as specified in Section 01300.
- E. Inspection and Test Plan (ITP)
1. Submit to Contract Administrator / Supervision Consultant no later than 14 calendar days from the commencement date.
2. No work covered by the ITP shall begin until the plan has been approved.

## F. Quality Control Procedures and Instructions

1. Submit to Contract Administrator / Supervision Consultant no later than 14 calendar days prior to using such procedures or instructions.
2. Do not begin work governed by Quality Control Procedures until such procedures have been approved by  the  Contract Administrator / SupervisionConsultant.

## G. Records Index Plan

1. Prepare an index of all project records which will be developed and maintained during progress of the Work.
2. Submit to Contract Administrator / Supervision Consultant no later than 30 calendar days from the commencement date.

## H. Material Inspection and Test Results

1. Submit at least 7 calendar days prior to incorporating items into the Work.
2. Report results to the Contract Administrator / Supervision Consultant indicating compliance or failure immediately upon receipt.
3. Submission of MethodStatements

Contractor shall submit a proper method statement for any particular activity on site requested by the Contract Administrator/ Supervision Consultant. The method Statement shall be clearly indicate the sequence of work for that particular activity ahd the way the Contractor will execute the work inaccordancewith the Contraotaionditions
